D 7036
26.10.35

Translation from the Russian newspaper "Novosty Dnia,"
26.10.35.

"THE MONK THAT PRISON IS WAITING FOR"

Ecclesiastical authorities of the Far East
are troubled by activities of a certain Ploujnikoff, who
was banished from the Harbin friary. Our editor's
office has just received information to the effect that
Ploujnikoff has started to deceive honest and trusting
people and is going to build a monastery in Trechrechie
(Three River Settlement in Manchuria).

In view of the above, the Pekin Orthodox
Mission has published the following warning:- The most
Reverend Bishop Ioann has received official information
from Harbin as follows:- Last year there was a monk
by the name of M.I. Ploujnikoff who resided in the Kazan-
Bogoroditsky friary and who was later banished from it.
In September he started to spread rumours that upon his
taking the habit of monk he was given the name of Mitrofaniy
by Bishop Victor, and received permission to establish
a friary in Trechrechie.

Bishop Victor on being informed of this stated
that he does not know Ploujnikoff and did not perform a
ceremony in bestowing the habit of monk upon him, neither
did he give him permission to establish a friary in
Trechrechie. The following statement was made by
Bishop Ioann:- "Warn the people against the collections."
...ing of a false claim to ecclesiastical
calling is rare in the experience of Russian clergy.
This particular case is the first one since the Russian
emigration to the Far East. Therefore, careful attention
must be given to this shocking imposture at the very
beginning.

It is hoped that the police will give their attention
to this matter and will put a stop to the activities of
"monk" Pleujnikoff.

D 7036
1935年10月26日

译自俄文报纸《Novosty Dnia》（今日新闻），
1935年10月26日。

“监狱正等待着的‘僧侣’”

远东教会当局对某位普卢日尼科夫（Ploujnikoff）的活动感到困扰，此人已被从哈尔滨的修道院驱逐。本报编辑部刚刚收到消息，称普卢日尼科夫开始欺骗诚实且轻信的人们，并打算在特列赫雷奇耶（Trechrechie，即满洲里的三江口定居点）建造一座修道院。

鉴于上述情况，北京东正教传教团发布了以下警告：——伊万主教（Bishop Ioann）阁下已收到来自哈尔滨的官方消息，内容如下：——去年有一位名为 M.I. 普卢日尼科夫（M.I. Ploujnikoff）的僧侣，居住在喀山圣母修道院（Kazan-Bogoroditsky friary），后已被该修道院驱逐。九月间，他开始散布谣言，声称他在受戒成为僧侣时，由维克多主教（Bishop Victor）赐名米特罗法尼（Mitrofaniy），并获得许可在特列赫雷奇耶建立一座修道院。

维克多主教在获悉此事后声明，他不认识普卢日尼科夫，也未为其举行授戒仪式，更未给予其在特列赫雷奇耶建立修道院的许可。伊万主教发表如下声明：“警告民众提防募捐。”……假冒神职召命的情形在俄罗斯神职人员的经验中实属罕见。此案例是自俄罗斯人移民远东以来的首例。因此，必须在这一令人震惊的欺诈行为伊始便予以密切关注。

希望警方关注此事，并制止“僧侣”普卢日尼科夫（Pleujnikoff）的活动。
